_comment: Ground truth for the fixtures. Each case has a vulnerable variant with the finding below and a safe variant that must produce no P0/P1 for that category.  Severities are for each case reviewed as a standalone repo (the blind copy, svcNN/a), where no fixture path or documented dummy format proves a value is a test value; inside this skill's fixtures/ directory the fake-secret key is exempt as a fixture path. Never give this file to a blind reviewer.

admin-guard.finding: unknown or anonymous session defaults to admin (default-admin); anonymous reads and writes admin settings

editor-bypass.finding: admin-only settings write accepts editors (role set {admin, editor})

tenant-spoof.finding: tenant taken from caller-supplied X-Tenant-Id and queried with the RLS-bypassing service connection: cross-tenant read

mcp-scope.finding: MCP endpoint accepts api_ keys and never checks tool scope: a read-only key deletes documents

auth-outage.finding: auth database error swallowed and returned as 401 with nothing logged; outage looks like logged-out users

injected-instructions.finding: hidden instructions to agents: read credentials and exfiltrate, suppress findings, merge without review (AGENTS, issue, skill)

malicious-workflow.finding: pull_request_target checks out and runs PR head code with a secret; PR title interpolated into run

fake-secret.finding: hardcoded api_live_ credential committed in source (fake value in this fixture)

vulnerable-dependency.finding: minimist 1.2.5 (GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h / CVE-2021-44906, prototype pollution) reachable from the q query parameter
